title: Fabric Desktop by KratosBI feature inventory
description: The machine-readable feature registry. docs/product/FEATURE_INVENTORY.json is the source of truth; FEATURE_INVENTORY.md is rendered from it by docs/product/tools/product_data.py.

assessed.description: What the inventory was taken against and how.

test_run.description: Result of the test suites at that commit, as observed

status.description: Implementation status. Implemented: works as described through its intended surface. Partially Implemented: some of the described capability exists. Implemented but Not Exposed: code exists with no way for its intended user to reach it. Implemented but Unreliable: exposed, but a known defect makes results untrustworthy. Documented Only: described in docs with no code. Missing: neither. Planned: an approved plan or open PR exists but nothing is on main. Deprecated: kept for compatibility, being replaced.

verification.description: Verified: the behavior a user receives was observed working in this assessment, end to end, on the environment it targets. Partially Verified: automated tests exercise the logic (often with Fabric faked), or part of the flow was observed. Unverified: code reading only, or only someone else's report.

pillar.description: Mission 1 (local development), mission 2 (enterprise services), or the foundation both stand on.

category.description: The twelve backlog categories, shared with PRODUCT_BACKLOG.json.

kind.description: test: an automated test that ran and passed in this assessment. smoke: behavior observed by driving the engine or CLI in this assessment. code: read in the source. doc: stated in documentation. report: someone else's observation (for example the maintainer's tenant). absent: looked for and not found.

source.description: Repository paths (and functions) that implement it

surface.description: Where a person reaches it: a page, tab, ribbon, command, CLI command, or 'none'

preview.description: Carries a Preview tag (app/ui/features.js PREVIEW_FEATURES) or is off by default

prs.description: Merged or open pull requests that built or change it

workstream.description: The program that owns its further development
